test_title: PYST 61: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Dassault Aviation and Reliance Aerostructure Limited (RAL), in June 2025, announced at Paris Air Show execution of an agreement to manufacture which of the following in India for the Global Market by 2028?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Falcon 2000 LXS Business Executive Jets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dassault Aviation** and **Reliance Aerostructure Limited (RAL)**, through their joint venture **Dassault Reliance Aerospace Limited (DRAL)**, announced a significant expansion of their partnership in **June 2025** during the **Paris Air Show**.
 
• The agreement outlines the execution of a plan to manufacture the **Falcon 2000 LXS Business Executive Jets** entirely in **India**, intended for the **Global Market**.
 
• The manufacturing process is slated to reach full scale with the first completed aircraft expected to be ready by the year **2028**.
 
• The production facility is located at the **Dhirubhai Ambani Aerospace Park (DAAP)** in the **Mihan SEZ** of **Nagpur, Maharashtra**.
 
• This move marks a transition from manufacturing components and sub-assemblies to the **Final Assembly Line (FAL)** for a complete business jet in **India**, supporting the **Make in India** initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dassault Aviation:** It is a premier **French** aerospace company that designs and builds military aircraft, such as the **Rafale** and **Mirage**, and the **Falcon** family of business jets. The company has a long-standing relationship with **India** dating back to the **1950s**.
 
• **Dassault Reliance Aerospace Limited (DRAL):** This is a **Joint Venture** established in **2017**, where **Reliance Aerostructure Limited** holds a **51%** stake and **Dassault Aviation** holds **49%**. It was initially formed to help fulfill **offset obligations** related to the **36 Rafale jet deal**.
 
• **Falcon 2000 LXS:** This specific model is a twin-engine **business jet** known for its efficiency and capability to land on **short runways**. It offers a range of approximately **4,000 nautical miles** (7,410 km) and can carry up to **10 passengers** in a widebody cabin configuration.
 
• **Strategic Significance:** By establishing a **Final Assembly Line** in **Nagpur**, the project enhances **India's** aerospace ecosystem, promotes **high-skill employment**, and positions the country as a competitive exporter in the **civil aviation** sector.
 
• **Historical Context:** Previously, the **Nagpur** facility was involved in producing **cockpit front sections** and **fuel tanks** for the **Falcon** jets. The **2025** agreement represents the ultimate scale-up to full aircraft integration and flight testing within **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Paris Air Show:** Held at **Le Bourget**, it is one of the world's oldest and largest aerospace exhibitions, often serving as a venue for major **international defense** and **civilian aviation** contracts.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** This project is a cornerstone for **self-reliance** in the **aerospace and defense** sectors, reducing dependency on imported finished aircraft and boosting **indigenous manufacturing** capabilities.
 
• **Technological Transfer:** The agreement involves a high degree of **technology transfer** from **France** to **India**, ensuring that **Indian** engineers and technicians are trained in world-class **aerospace assembly** standards.
